name: chrome-devtools-mcp
one_liner: Lets an AI coding assistant open a real Chrome browser, click around, and read performance/network data — like giving the AI its own pair of hands and eyes on the web.
buyer: Not a product a business buys — it's a free developer tool that AI coding-agent builders wire into their own products.
business_use_cases: An AI coding-agent startup uses it under the hood to let their agent test and debug the web apps it writes.
A QA automation team uses it to have an agent flag performance regressions on every deploy.
A freelance web developer uses it locally to have Claude Code diagnose slow pages for clients.

money_ideas.idea: No monetization path for an outside operator; value accrues to whoever builds the end-user agent product on top of it.

steal_this: Wire it into Claude Code and offer a paid 'website performance audit in an hour' service to small business clients using the trace output as the deliverable.
